Asset type: final photographic background for the Cakes by Yas bakery homepage hero, landscape 16:9, highest available native detail.
Input image 1 is the PROTECTED REAL PRODUCT photographed by this business. Retain this exact one-tier handmade ivory birthday cake, gold crown with pale pink jewels, gold butterfly decorations, pink/white/gold sphere clusters, white cake board with narrow gold rim, and the existing gold Happy Birthday decoration. Maintain their actual locations, proportions, cake silhouette, irregular buttercream spatula marks, piping and material appearance. No candles: this cake has none. Do not redesign or upgrade the product. Do not render a new logo or any added text.
Primary request: art-direct a memorable premium birthday bakery campaign photograph around this existing cake, coherent with a warm ivory/coral identity. Replace the domestic background and reframe into a deliberately composed editorial still life, not a catalog cutout and not a 3D render.
Composition: wide 16:9 photograph, cake upright on its existing board on an ivory matte tabletop, positioned on the RIGHT around x74% of the image; cake plus crown occupy about 65% of image height from y19% to y84%, board fully visible. Keep LEFT 52% and top 12% calm, nearly uniform warm ivory (#FAF5EE) with sufficient quiet space for dark large website typography, which will be added in HTML. Avoid any props or strong shadows in this text area. Leave breathing room around the cake and board; avoid an extreme macro crop. Camera near cake mid-height, slight look down showing the top, natural 70mm commercial food-photo perspective.
Brand set styling: a single real coral satin gift ribbon (#EA677D) trails loosely on the tabletop near the right foreground, with one natural broad curling gesture, subtle textile grain and plausible gravity. It must remain an accessory outside the cake board, not wrap around or alter the cake. The ribbon's curved gesture gently echoes the curving new identity; no giant bows, no drawn symbols. The seamless backdrop is warm ivory, with a very restrained pale rose (#F8A8B1) reflection near the right edge. Light, joyful, tactile and personal, with editorial restraint.
Lighting: believable large diffused window from upper left with gentle right fill; delicate contact shadows under the board and ribbon; natural gold reflections without blown highlights. Warm-neutral white balance, cream remains ivory not yellow. Restrained depth of field, whole cake and crown readable and sharply photographed, background soft but no fake bokeh.
Realism: retain authentic handmade icing variation and fine pores, believable paper topper edges, intricate crown edges and real reflective gold surfaces. Do not smooth into plastic or add exaggerated texture. No floating objects, confetti, flowers, utensils, hands, extra desserts, glitter, stars, fantasy light, excessive saturation, gradient-blob graphics, watermark, packaging, branded lettering or artificial shine. This must read as a carefully art-directed real product photograph of the provided cake.
Deliver a single finished photograph only, no layout or contact sheet.
